C1240.title: LexisNexis Launches a Synthetic Identity Fraud Detection Score
C1240.summary: In July 2021, LexisNexis Risk Solutions announced Fraud Intelligence Synthetic Score. The product analyzes hundreds of identity characteristics and events to identify inconsistencies and synthetic fraud patterns in new-account applications. It produces a three-digit risk score from 001 to 998 to help investigation teams prioritize higher-risk applications.
